review: Mayukha Curations turned our home courtyard into a magical traditional wonderland! The marigold work and fresh jasmine aroma were praised by every single guest. Truly stress-free execution.
The pastel rose and lotus backdrop was beyond beautiful! The team was punctual, attentive to every detail, and handled post-event teardown without any disruption.
Extremely tasteful floral architecture. They understood our theme perfectly and brought our dream cradle decor to life within our budget. Highly recommended!
